fields.description: Creekside Residence brings one- to three-bedroom apartments to the mangrove edge of Al Zorah. Mediterranean-inspired architecture, a creek-facing entrance and shared landscaped spaces shape its quieter waterfront setting.

sources.label: Creekside · branded sales presentation, broker mirror

overview: The apartment mix ranges from compact one-bedroom homes to larger three-bedroom layouts. Compare the shape and usable outdoor space of the specific plan, rather than choosing by bedroom count alone.
research.locationNote: Creekside Residence overlooks the creek and mangroves in Al Zorah, Ajman. Golf, marina and resort attractions belong to the wider destination; access and membership conditions require confirmation.
research.priceNote: Original guide: AED 711,000. EZRE: AED 846,462 for a selected one-bedroom home. No current developer quote verified.
research.paymentNote: Original option 1 below. EZRE reports 10/20/10/60 over three post-handover years; Bayut 5/45/10/40 over two. Reconfirm current terms.
research.handoverNote: Developer forecast: March 2028; original calendar: 31 March 2028. Completion remains unverified.
